recommended_wording: As a proof-of-concept (SI), CoordRep enables cross-domain active-site homology search between molecular coordination complexes and extended framework nodes. In a pilot study of 500 MOF/coordination-polymer nodes and 3000 molecular reference records, the top-1 coordination-homology match was chemically reasonable in 100% of audited cases. Main-text promotion requires hard-control benchmarks demonstrating that higher-order CoordRep fields (bridge topology, haptic modes, shape/stereo) add value beyond metal/CN/donor matching.
